title: Information Manager
purpose: Overall information management lead across project environments; ensures S2 information requirements and S3 CDE configuration are implemented, maintained, and compliant with ISO 19650 frameworks. Holds top-level CDE project admin authority.
authority_statements: Project Admin authority in ACC / CDE
Full authority to configure projects, manage members, and manage folder permissions
Authority to enforce S2 information requirements and S3 CDE configurations
Authority to send transmittals, run reviews/approvals, and manage issues across CDE
May delegate daily CDE administration to CDE Manager
responsibilities: Define and oversee project CDE configuration and access control policies
Ensure organizational information requirements (OIR/AIR) and project information requirements (PIR/EIR) are embedded in project instruments
Oversee compliance with ISO 19650 information exchange protocols
Manage CDE-level deviations and exceptions in coordination with BIM governance
accountabilities: Overall integrity and security of the project CDE environment
Compliance of project information structure with ISO 19650 and S2 standards
approvals: CDE project configuration and folder permission sets
User access authorization and external party onboarding
Formal information transmittals and review state transitions
inputs: Project BEP and CDE setup specifications
Member access requests from Project Manager
outputs: Approved CDE roles and permissions matrix
